security malicious-sources ip-addresses(1)		BIG-IP TMSH Manual		security malicious-sources ip-addresses(1)

NAME
       ip-addresses - Displays the malicious source IP addresses.

MODULE
       security malicious-sources

SYNTAX
       Display information about the ip-addresses component within the security malicious-sources module using the following
       syntax.

   DISPLAY
	show ip-addresses
	  options:
	    field-fmt

DESCRIPTION
       You can use the ip-addresses component to display the malicious source IP addresses.

EXAMPLES
       show ip-addresses

       Display the list of detected malicious source IP addresses.

OPTIONS
       For information about the options that you can use with the command show, see help show.

SEE ALSO
       show, tmsh
